note.zh-TW: 教材部分頁面與模板註解稱長期負債（舊稱）。同一張名詞卡也用於「非流動負債合計」列。
note.en: Some course pages and template notes say long-term liabilities, an older term. The same card serves the total non-current liabilities line.

definition.zh-TW:
到期日在一年以後的負債，例如長期借款與應付公司債。

它和流動負債的分界同樣是一年：一年內要清償的是流動負債，其餘是非流動負債。教材部分頁面與模板註解稱它為長期負債，是舊稱。
definition.en:
Liabilities falling due more than a year away, such as long-term borrowings and bonds payable.

The dividing line from current liabilities is again one year: amounts due within a year are current, the rest are non-current. Some course pages and template notes call them long-term liabilities, an older name.

example.zh-TW: 位置：資產負債表流動負債之後的分組標題，課程版面底下只有長期借款一列；同一張名詞卡也用於「非流動負債合計」列。它和股東權益合起來就是長期資金。本課故事沒有長期借款，所以這一區是 0。
example.en: Where it sits: the group heading after current liabilities on the balance sheet; in the course layout it contains only long-term borrowings, and this same card covers the total non-current liabilities line. Together with equity it makes up long-term funds. The course story has no long-term borrowing, so the section is zero.

misconception.zh-TW: 以為非流動負債不用擔心、只有流動負債才會還不起。長期借款終究要還，而且每年都有利息；長期資金占固定資產比率和負債比率就是在看這部分的壓力。
misconception.en: Assuming non-current liabilities are nothing to worry about and only current ones can go unpaid. Long-term borrowings still fall due and carry interest every year; the long-term funds to property, plant and equipment ratio and the debt ratio measure exactly that burden.
